description:
**Blocked by d06.2 + d06.10 (Markdown subsystem must already be on
VDom; TextBlock and ThinkingBlock both delegate to it). Read deck
§13 "Worked example: streaming Markdown" before starting — the
TextBlock conversion is the worked example, walk through it
end-to-end before writing code.**

Migrate the three remaining streaming/transcript-content
components: `TextBlock`, `ThinkingBlock`, `CompactionSummaryMessage`.

**Read first:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message/text_block.ex`
  (~75 lines). The streaming text block. Today owns an
  `MdRender` and implements `update/2` + `finalize/2`. Worked
  example in deck §13.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message/thinking_block.ex`
  (~50 lines). Same pattern as TextBlock but renders thinking
  content (different theme color, optional hidden-thinking label).
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/compaction_summary_message.ex`
  (~100 lines). Renders the summary that appears after
  `/compact`. Static — plain text + theme styling, no streaming
  state.
- The post-d06.10 markdown subsystem: `Components.Markdown` will
  now be a function module returning a VFlow of memoized blocks.
  TextBlock/ThinkingBlock just call it.
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/transcript_test.exs` and
  any per-component tests under
  `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message/`.

**Target shape:**
- TextBlock becomes `def render(%{snapshot: snap} = props, ctx, h)`
  returning `Components.Markdown.render(%{text: snap}, ctx, h)`
  wrapped in a small VFlow with the assistant-message gutter/style.
- ThinkingBlock similar but with `ctx.hide_thinking` honored: when
  true, render `%VText{text: ctx.hidden_thinking_label, style:
  Theme.fg(theme, :dim, ...)}` instead of the markdown.
- CompactionSummaryMessage is pure — a VFlow of VText nodes for
  the summary header and body, styled per theme.
- Snapshots flow as **props from the parent** (Transcript hole
  reads them off the live `%MessageState{}` and passes them in).
  The `update/2` and `finalize/2` callbacks on these modules go
  away. The ThinkingBlock `pending` flag (if it exists) becomes a
  prop from the parent, not internal state.

**Acceptance:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/transcript_test.exs` stays
  100% green.
- Per-component test files (find via `ls apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/assistant_message/`)
  stay green or are updated to the new prop shape (port any
  preserved-behaviour assertions verbatim).
- Streaming smoke (tmux): paste a long markdown response and
  watch tokens append. Telemetry confirms exactly one set_state
  per delta on the hook cell. Cache hit ratio after first
  paragraph commits is ≥ 95% per delta during steady streaming.
- Modules' `defstruct` and `@behaviour OctoPi.TUI.Component`
  (legacy shape) deleted. Final modules each ~30-50 LoC.
- `grep -rn "@behaviour.*StreamingComponent" apps/octo_pi_tui` returns 0.

comments.text: Superseded by the tui2 architecture decision in docs/tui-architecture.md. The d06 plan refactored octo_pi_tui in place; the new direction builds octo_pi_tui2 as a parallel implementation on Filament, leaving octo_pi_tui frozen. New epics: opi-58c, opi-pyl, opi-yhj, opi-t3t, opi-ow9, opi-4tr, opi-m6b. Closing without further work.
